Iran Threatens US Navy Officers After Minab Children Deaths

Iran announced that a third United States warship has been deployed in the Middle East, saying the move raises the risk of war, and vowed to punish those responsible for the killing of children in Minab. The Iranian statement also threatened two U.S. Navy officers, saying they would be located.
